observation.command:
cat <<'EOF' | wc -w
PR: OpenHands/OpenHands #16860 https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/16860 (merged, fixes #16302).
1. Allow-list change. Replaces build-time all-catalog-on behavior with an explicit enabled_skills allow-list over the bundled @openhands/extensions catalog, defaulting to the 11 defaultEnabled entries; disabled_skills still governs user- and project-authored skills, and src/utils/skill-enablement.ts is the single rule source (deny-list wins; non-catalog skills stay on unless denied).
2. Implementation files. src/utils/skill-enablement.ts https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/blob/fae6ad8a0ccaaa5ec8f87aac36abe321e72fbb2c/src/utils/skill-enablement.ts supplies CATALOG_SKILL_NAMES, buildSkillEnablementFilter, and one-shot migrateSkillEnablement. src/hooks/use-skill-enablement.ts https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/blob/fae6ad8a0ccaaa5ec8f87aac36abe321e72fbb2c/src/hooks/use-skill-enablement.ts shares hydrate/auto-save/toggle logic between the Customize page and the conversation drawer; cloud backends keep deny-list governance.
3. Test runner. Per the upstream PR report: npx vitest run gives 5064 passed, one unrelated pre-existing dev-with-automation SIGHUP failure; npm run lint and npm run check-translation-completeness are clean; the 4 new keys are translated across all 15 locales.
4. New tests. __tests__/utils/skill-enablement.test.ts https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/blob/fae6ad8a0ccaaa5ec8f87aac36abe321e72fbb2c/__tests__/utils/skill-enablement.test.ts covers resolution, deny-veto, and every migration branch; __tests__/hooks/use-migrate-enabled-skills.test.tsx covers one-shot migration, cloud skip, and no write after a failed settings load; adapter assertions now exclude add-javadoc.
5. Uncertainty. I personally ran no tests or live verification, relying only on the PR report. Cloud-side behavior (the server catalog never reads enabled_skills), slash-command loading, and the no-Core-tier deviation remain unverified.
EOF
